description: I'm Sourav Garai, a first-year B.Tech student in AI and Cybersecurity at The Neotia University. I turn ideas into working web applications, AI tools, chatbots and automation systems, using AI-assisted development to bring them to life. I enjoy taking on ambitious problems, learning through building and improving my projects through real testing. My focus is simple: build useful technology, keep learning and turn curiosity into something people can actually use.
